def paginate(total, per_page):  
    pages = total // per_page  
    last = total % per_page  
    return pages, last

def moving_sum(values, i, window):
    start = max(0, i - window + 1)
    total = sum(values[start:i+1])
    return total

import unittest
from target import allocate

class TestAllocateFunction(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_allocate_with_valid_input(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [20, 30, 50])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [40, 60, 100])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 0)

    def test_allocate_with_zero_weights(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [0, 0, 0])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [0, 0, 0])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 100)

    def test_allocate_with_negative_weights(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [20, -10, 50])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [40, 0, 100])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 0)

    def test_allocate_with_large_weights(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [1000, 1000, 1000])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [100, 100, 100])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 0)

    def test_allocate_with_float_weights(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [20.5, 30.25, 49.25])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [41, 30, 49])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 0)

    def test_allocate_with_one_weight(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [100])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [100])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 0)

    def test_allocate_with_no_weights(self):
        parts, rest = allocate(100, [])
        self.assertEqual(parts, [])
        self.assertEqual(rest, 100)
